Resource-Constrained Job Shop with Provisioner.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Resource_Provisioner, General_Hospital_Triage

payload.content: Ops plan (Triage, iter 1): My job queue has 8 triage step-0 tasks (Patient_0..Patient_7). Inventory at General_Hospital is comfortable: IV_Kits 20, PPE_Sets 21 — no top-up needed, so no public bottleneck request this phase (avoid holding cost). Per RP-target default I will NOT transfer anything (IV/PPE are bottlenecks; Radiology already posted surplus offers publicly anyway). Next step: I'll refresh the queue and slot all 8 triage steps at their earliest feasible starts, spread across capacity 4. No duplicates. If RP has stabilization transfers inbound for other departments, no action needed from my side.

Ops plan (Resource_Provisioner, iter 1): Checked both hospitals — GH has IV 20 / PPE 21, StM has IV 20 / PPE 21. Both are already well above safe buffers (IV>=6, PPE>=8), no failures, no alerts, no imbalance between the two hospitals. So no stabilization transfers this phase — sending more would only create holding cost. I will not transfer anything this iteration (RP-target default). If Triage sees any shortage or failure at General_Hospital during scheduling, flag it here immediately and I'll top up in the same phase. Next iteration I'll re-check inventories and any requests before acting. (phase=planning, iter=1)
